verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents provisioning on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes and "300+ providers," with a Registry listing 316 packages usable from every supported language. Hands-on users report managing AWS, GCP and Kubernetes resources with it. missing for 10: explicit evidence of SaaS-provider coverage beyond Cloudflare (SaaS breadth is only implied by the provider count), and a community report that Azure provider support lagged behind Terraform ('always late to the game') leaves provider currency unproven.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage resources across all major clouds and SaaS providers through a broad provider ecosystem

citations.quote: Pulumi automatically provisions and manages your resources on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, and 300+ providers
Featured packages ... AWS ... Azure Native ... Google Cloud ... Kubernetes ... Packages 316
Each language is equally capable and supports the full surface area of all Pulumi Registry providers.
Install the CLI and deploy your first stack to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, or Cloudflare.
